title: 用 AI 写邮件，怎么做到有用又不乱承诺？
How do you draft email without inventing commitments?
answer: 先说明收件人关系、目的、已确认事实和不能答应的内容。第一轮只生成草稿，不直接发送。尤其检查价格、交期和附件是否真的存在。
State the relationship, purpose, confirmed facts and prohibited commitments. Generate a draft first, without sending it. Check prices, dates and whether referenced attachments actually exist.
steps: 列出这封邮件只想达成的一件事。
Define the one purpose of the email.
提供真实可用的事实，缺项留空。
Supply verified facts and leave gaps explicit.
检查称呼、承诺、附件后再自己发送。
Review recipient, commitments and attachments before sending.
exercise: 写一封请求补充商品规格的简短邮件，只询问型号与数量，不承诺报价和交期，不提不存在的附件。
Draft a short request for model and quantity details without promising prices or delivery dates or mentioning nonexistent attachments.
problem: 出现“已为您安排”却没实际安排时，改成准确的询问或待确认说法。
Replace arrangements have been made with an accurate question or pending status when no action occurred.
check: 邮件只包含可兑现的信息，下一步明确。
The draft contains supportable statements and a clear next step.

title: 会议纪要里怎么区分决定和建议？
How do you separate meeting decisions from suggestions?
answer: 纪要不是把聊天写得正式，而是保留谁决定了什么、谁还没确认。建议、争议和决定要分开。负责人和期限只有在记录明确时才能填写。
Minutes preserve decisions and unresolved matters rather than merely formalizing conversation. Separate proposals, disputes and decisions. Add owners and deadlines only when stated.
steps: 用几句包含“建议、同意、再看看”的练习记录。
Prepare notes with suggestions, agreement and unresolved discussion.
让 AI 分类并附原句。
Request categories with source sentences.
检查建议有没有被升级为决定。
Check that suggestions were not promoted to decisions.
exercise: 只提取明确决定；“建议”“考虑”进入讨论栏。行动项缺负责人或日期时标待确认：[练习记录]。
Extract explicit decisions only. Put suggestions in discussion and mark missing action owners or dates unknown: [notes].
problem: 会议里有人被提名不等于已经接下任务，确认责任前不要写成已指派。
Being mentioned as a possible owner does not establish acceptance.
check: 每条决定和行动都能找到对应原句。
Each decision and action traces to an original sentence.

title: 表格太乱，AI 清洗前先定什么规则？
What rules come before AI spreadsheet cleaning?
answer: 先统一字段含义、单位和缺失值，再谈格式漂亮。前导零可能属于编号，空白不是零，同名也可能不同规格。清洗先生成副本和变更说明，别覆盖源表。
Define fields, units and missing values before formatting. Leading zeros may be part of IDs; blanks are not zero; names can hide different variants. Work on a copy with a change log.
steps: 标注哪些列是编号、数量和金额。
Label ID, quantity and amount columns.
写清单位换算及空值规则。
Define conversions and missing-value rules.
对比清洗前后行数与关键合计。
Compare row counts and key totals before and after.
exercise: 只建议清洗规则，不直接改表。保留编号前导零，未知数量不填0，规格不同不合并。
Suggest cleaning rules without editing: preserve leading zeros, leave unknown quantities unknown and keep variants separate.
problem: 合计变化时先查丢行、单位和重复口径，不默认变化就是正确去重。
If totals change, inspect missing rows, units and duplicate rules before accepting the result.
check: 所有改动有规则依据，源表可恢复。
Changes follow explicit rules and the original remains recoverable.

title: 用 AI 核对库存，第一步为什么只列异常？
Why start AI inventory checking with an exception list?
answer: 账面、实物、在途与预留库存不是同一个概念。先明确核对口径，再用工具找差异，交给负责人确认。不能让语言模型猜一遍后直接改真实库存。
Book, physical, in-transit and reserved stock are different measures. Define what is being reconciled, list discrepancies and have an owner confirm them before any stock update.
steps: 用虚构商品做两张小表，附单位和时间。
Create two fictional product tables with units and timestamps.
按商品编号与规格匹配。
Match by item ID and specification.
输出差异及原始行，不自动修账。
Report differences with source rows without adjusting records.
exercise: 对照两份练习库存表，只列无法匹配、数量不同、单位不同的行。不要决定哪一份正确，不回写（把结果改回原系统或原表）。
Compare two practice stock tables and list unmatched items, quantity differences and unit mismatches. Do not decide which is correct or write back (changing the original system or sheet).
problem: 名称相似却规格不同要分开，模糊匹配只作候选不能当结论。
Keep differing variants separate; fuzzy matching supplies candidates, not confirmed matches.
check: 每条异常可追溯，真实更正仍由业务负责人确认。
Every exception is traceable and real adjustments require an authorized owner.

title: AI 写产品文案，哪些信息绝对不能编？
What must AI never invent in product copy?
answer: 尺寸、材质、认证、适用范围和效果必须有依据。AI 可以帮你把说明写清楚，但不能把竞品功能搬到自己产品上。先做事实表，再写文案，最后反查每一句。

Dimensions, materials, certifications, compatibility and results need evidence. AI can improve clarity but must not import competitor features. Build a fact sheet before drafting and trace each claim back afterward.
steps: 整理已确认参数和待确认参数。
Separate confirmed and unknown specifications.
给定使用场景与读者。
Specify context and audience.
逐句对照事实表，删除夸大效果。
Trace each sentence and remove unsupported benefits.
exercise: 只根据这份参数表写最多五条产品说明。事实不够就少写，未知参数不补，不新增认证或效果：[参数]。
Write up to five product points using the supplied specification only. Use fewer when facts are insufficient; invent no specifications, certifications or benefits: [specs].
problem: 模型自动加“防水”等常见卖点时，指出源表没有，要求删除并检查同类添加。
If it adds a familiar feature such as waterproofing, remove it and inspect other unsupported additions.
check: 所有产品承诺都能在确认资料中定位。
Every product claim can be located in confirmed material.

title: AI 翻译能直接发客户吗？怎么检查？
How should you review an AI translation before sharing?
answer: 翻译要保留数字、条件、否定和术语，不能只看语句流畅。专业合同、医疗等高风险材料需要适合的专业复核。普通办公先用术语表和逐项核对提高一致性。
Check numbers, conditions, negation and terminology rather than fluency alone. High-stakes material needs qualified review. For ordinary office text, use a glossary and targeted checks.
steps: 列出不可翻错的产品名与术语。
List product names and key terms.
要求保留段落对应，标出歧义。
Preserve paragraph alignment and flag ambiguity.
核对数字、单位及“不得、除非”等限制。
Review figures, units and negative or conditional clauses.
exercise: 翻译这份练习说明，保留数字单位，使用附带术语表。遇歧义列两种理解，不自行决定：[文字]。
Translate this practice instruction with the glossary, preserving numbers and units. List alternative readings for ambiguity rather than deciding silently.
problem: 回译相似不证明翻译正确，仍要看原句条件和专业术语。
A similar back-translation does not establish correctness; review original conditions and terms.
check: 关键约束没有变，不能确定的地方可见。
Critical constraints remain intact and uncertainties are visible.

title: 周报怎么用 AI 整理，不把计划写成成果？
How do you use AI for a weekly report honestly?
answer: 把实际完成、进行中、计划和阻断分开。AI 能把流水账整理清楚，但不能把“准备做”改写为“成功交付”。成果最好附文件、记录或可查看链接。
Separate completed, ongoing, planned and blocked work. AI can organize notes but must not turn intention into delivery. Attach an inspectable artifact or record where available.
steps: 把原始记录逐项标状态。
Label each raw note with its actual state.
提供对应产物或明确没有。
Attach an output or state that none exists.
检查改稿是否扩大结果。
Check that the rewrite does not exaggerate outcomes.
exercise: 按已完成、进行中、阻断、下周计划整理周报。没有回执的发布或交付不能写成功：[记录]。
Organize completed, ongoing, blocked and planned work. Do not claim publication or delivery without evidence: [notes].
problem: “测试过”要说明范围，不把一条样本通过写成全部功能验证。
Specify testing scope instead of turning one passing example into complete validation.
check: 读者能区分实际产出和未来打算。
Readers can distinguish actual outputs from intentions.

title: OCR 是什么？识别单据后还要核对什么？
What is OCR, and what should you check on a receipt?
answer: OCR 把图片里的文字转为可处理文本，不保证数字和表格关系都正确。单据还涉及字段理解、单位及业务规则。先保留原图位置，让人能核对，不直接把识别值当正式记录。

OCR turns image text into machine-readable text but can misread digits and table structure. Documents also require field interpretation, units and business rules. Preserve source locations for review before creating official records.
steps: 用虚构单据图片练习，不用客户原单。
Practice with a fictional receipt image.
提取字段时附原文位置和不清楚项。
Attach source locations and uncertainty to extracted fields.
检查小数点、负号、数量与单位。
Check decimals, negative signs, quantities and units.
exercise: 提取这张练习单据的商品、数量、单位。看不清写待确认，保留原文，不推断缺失价格。
Extract item, quantity and unit from this practice receipt. Mark unreadable values unknown, preserve source text and do not infer prices.
problem: 识别置信度高也可能错，关键字段仍按业务风险复核。
High recognition confidence can still be wrong; review critical fields according to risk.
check: 每个重要数值可对照原图，未识别项没有被悄悄填满。
Critical values trace to the image and unreadable fields are not silently filled.

title: 企业知识库从哪里开始，不是把文件全上传？
How do you start a business knowledge base?
answer: 先选一个部门反复问的主题，整理有效版本、负责人与适用范围。重复、过期和冲突资料会把答案带偏。小范围做对后再增加资料，不先堆满整个网盘。
Choose one recurring question area and organize current versions, owners and scope. Duplicate or conflicting material undermines answers. Get a small set working before expanding to the whole drive.
steps: 收集一个主题的现行说明。
Collect current material on one topic.
去掉过期副本并记录负责人。
Remove obsolete duplicates from the working set and record owners.
写已知、未知和冲突问题测试。
Test supported, unsupported and conflicting questions.
exercise: 为这几份练习制度设计知识库目录，按有效版本、适用对象、负责人整理；冲突先列出，不自行裁决。
Organize these practice policies by current version, audience and owner. List conflicts without deciding them silently.
problem: 检索答错先检查资料版本与覆盖，再考虑模型。
For wrong answers, inspect source versions and coverage before changing the model.
check: 问答能回到有效规则，没有资料时会转人工确认。
Answers point to current rules and missing information prompts human review.

title: AI 怎么把老师傅经验整理成操作步骤？
How do you turn experience into a usable procedure?
answer: 先访谈实际操作者，再整理步骤、前提、例外和完成标准。AI 不在现场，不该补它没见过的设备按钮或安全动作。让另一位同事按稿试走，再修订。

Interview the actual operator and document steps, prerequisites, exceptions and completion checks. AI should not invent unseen controls or safety actions. Have another colleague walk through the draft before finalizing.
steps: 记录操作者真实做法和常见错误。
Record actual practice and common errors.
按一步一个动作整理，保留不确定处。
Write one action per step and retain uncertainties.
由熟悉流程的人检查并批准版本。
Have a knowledgeable owner review and approve a version.
exercise: 把访谈整理为准备、操作、异常、完成检查四部分。未提到的按钮和安全事项写待现场确认，不编细节。
Organize this interview into preparation, actions, exceptions and completion checks. Flag unknown controls and safety details for on-site confirmation.
problem: 步骤顺序和现场不符时，以核实后的实际流程修正，不为文案顺畅改现场规则。
Correct the draft from verified practice rather than changing operational rules for smoother prose.
check: 新手可按步骤找到动作，流程负责人确认关键限制。
A beginner can follow actions and the owner confirms critical constraints.
